mapper.insert: INSERT INTO MARKET_DAILY_CLOSE (symbol, trade_date, close_price, source, created_at) VALUES (UPPER(#{symbol}), #{tradeDate}, #{closePrice}, #{source}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.select: SELECT id, symbol, trade_date, close_price, source, created_at FROM ( SELECT id, symbol, trade_date, close_price, source, created_at FROM MARKET_DAILY_CLOSE WHERE UPPER(symbol) = UPPER(#{symbol}) ORDER BY trade_date DESC LIMIT #{limit} ) RECENT_CLOSES ORDER BY trade_date ASC
